name: Trae
summary: ByteDance's AI coding environment (TraeCode) and work assistant (TraeWork).
description: Trae is a set of AI tools from ByteDance. TraeCode is a coding environment with an AI agent that writes and edits code, and TraeWork is a general work assistant available on desktop and the web. The plans page lists Lite at $3 per month, Pro at $10 per month with $20 of basic usage and unlimited autocomplete, and Pro+ at $30 per month. A free version can be downloaded.

howToUse.title: Open Trae
howToUse.description: Open Trae, the ByteDance tools. TraeCode and TraeWork can be downloaded, including a free version.

howToUse.title: Write code in TraeCode
howToUse.description: In the TraeCode coding environment, the agent writes new code and edits files you already have.

howToUse.title: Use TraeWork
howToUse.description: Open TraeWork on the desktop or on the web and use it as a general work assistant.

howToUse.title: Compare Lite, Pro, and Pro+
howToUse.description: The plans page lists Lite at $3 a month. Pro is $10 a month with $20 of basic usage and unlimited autocomplete. Pro+ is $30 a month.
